title.narrative: of GNorganised global level events and processes that engage Coalition members

description.narrative: of GNorganised global level events and processes that engage Coalition members

comment.narrative: The Coalition established as priority for 2023 to facilitate inclusion of voices from affected Member States in the relevant global conversations. In this regard Coalition members especially affected Member States have engaged in the following GNled events and processes at global level participation in ECOSOC Humanitarian Affairs Segment sideevent with facilitation of g7 countries participation Sierra Leone DRC. facilitated the organization of the GNled Leadership Dialogue at the Food Systems Summit Stock Taking Moment centered on Sahel with participation of Chad National Convenor. facilitated the organization of the UNGA HighLevel roundtable on food security and the participation of affected Member States such as Somalia or South Sudan. participation in the Geneva briefing and facilitation of Coalition members interventions e.g. CGIAR.The Coalition also led or participated in events in high level fora and systematically used and promoted GN analysis to feed in and frame the conversations Least Developed Countries Global Conference LDC5 Humanitarian Networks and Partnerships Week the Stockholm Forum on Peace and Development the UNFCCC Africa Climate Week the World Committee on Food Security and the World Food Forum.

title.narrative: of coalition consultations (general and workstream specific)

description.narrative: of coalition consultations (general and workstream specific)

comment.narrative: In addition to the 12 bilateral consultations undertaken in Q1 2023 the Coalition has organized individual and collective consultations regarding key engagements two meetings of the advocacy workstream to discuss 2023 engagements individual consultations with affected Member States on the COP28 Declaration on Climate Relief Recovery and Peace collective consultation of the membership on the same Declaration collective consultations on the research project presented by the Research workstream colead and a collective consultation on the Multi Stakeholder Pledges on Agriculture food systems and food security of the Global Refugee Forum. The Coalition also had four bilateral inperson consultations with national conveners at the Food Systems Summit Stock Taking moment or at the World Committee on Food Security. In Sudan and in Somalia the Coalition conducted inperson consultations with countrylevel staff of Coalition members as part of GN led processes to support National Convenors.
